title: kanban ledger routines/<name>.yaml (format 3)
description: A kanban/routines/<name>.yaml: a kind of work kanban adds an issue for, again and again. Derived from docs/ledger.md (Routines); where they differ, ledger.md is right. The file's name is the routine's name (one plain name). It needs schedule, on, or both. Any other key is allowed and kept.

title.description: Required. The title of each issue it adds.

brief.description: The brief.md of each issue it adds.

profile.description: Copied into each issue it adds.

repo.description: Copied into each issue it adds. One of config.yaml repos, which a schema of one file can't check.

schedule.description: Fires at these times: cron's five fields (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week), in config.yaml timezone, else UTC. kanban lint checks each field.

on.description: Fires when any issue moves into one of these statuses, except an issue this routine added.

open.description: Fires only while fewer than this many of the issues it added are not done. Default 1.
